notes.title: Version 1.2 is live!
notes.notes:
A new version of Lendas do Pebol is available! Check out the changes!

- Performance improvements
- Multiplayer screen interface improvements

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Version 1.1 is now live! Now with multiplayer support!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Since release, we have been working to improve our game even more!
With the current update (version 1.1), players will be able to compete in multiplayer mode!
To play a local match, it is required the combination of one keyboard and one controller (like the Xbox controller). We are working in allowing both players to play with controllers, but that will be in a future update.
Want to play online? No problem! Use the Steam Remote Play! Invite a friend for a match and show him who is the best! It is also required that one of the players use a controller. You only need one copy of Lendas do Pebol to play with your friends using this feature!

The next update will be focussed on Steam Achievements! See you next time! Enjoy our game!

notes.title: Lendas do Pebol is here! Version 1.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It is finally release day! The beta build was substituted by the 1.0 version!
This version is focused on optimization! Some quality of life improvements, like increased controller support, are also included! (you should be able to navigate on the menus using only the controller)
Leave your feedback if you encounter any issue!
Soon we will release the update schedule! Stay tuned, the next update will add local multiplayer support!
Thank you for your attention! See you next time!
